# connection check: HOST A ROOM fails (an address that cannot resolve), TEST CONNECTION runs, its result popup, back to the main menu
# Generated by tools/console-1.2/gen_online.py (edit the generator, not this file). One console, the real online service, no opponent: the failure popup is the only way to the connection test and the isolated build's env reader refuses MSC_ONLINE_URL (no / or : in a value), so the console run needs a Wi-Fi with no internet (BY HAND); the host proof points the game at a loopback port nobody listens on
# Menus are driven by pad presses only; the public name comes from MSC_ONLINE_NAME in the run's np-player.txt (nothing is typed). Every screen logs a STATE line: a missing one is a TIMEOUT
# line of the script and the run is INVALID.
mash 100 20 scene == 0
log STATE title screen
mash 100 30 scene != 0
wait scene == 1 || scene == 10
wait scene == 10 || nbuttons >= 8
if scene == 10
log first run: no save file, accepting 'create save data'
wait nbuttons >= 2
idle 10
mash 100 30 scene == 1
wait nbuttons >= 8
endif
wait onctx == 0
log STATE main menu
idle 30
# The main menu is a ring picked by stick/D-pad angle; Multiplayer (ctx 1) is up-left.
hold 30 0 -80 80
wait onctx == 1 120
idle 10
log STATE pointer on multiplayer
idle 20
press 100
wait scene == 10 1200
log STATE multiplayer mode choice
wait nbuttons >= 3 900
idle 60
mash 8 15 onctx == 0 180
idle 10
press 100
log chose online
wait scene == 1 900
wait scene == 10 1200
wait nbuttons >= 3 900
log STATE online choice popup
idle 60
idle 10
press 100
log chose host
# the account step cannot reach the service: the failure popup with TEST CONNECTION as its second button
wait nbuttons >= 2 3600
log STATE failure popup with the test offered
idle 60
press 4
idle 20
press 100
log chose test connection
# the test's result popup (one OK)
idle 300
wait nbuttons >= 1 3600
log STATE result popup
idle 120
press 100
wait scene == 1 1800
idle 60
log STATE back in the main menu after the test
exit
